summary: Jeremy returns from vacation to analyze market dynamics heading into 2026. He's bullish overall, expecting low volatility and strong economic data in Q1. Top picks include Amazon, Celsius, and American Express. Warns about potential Q2-Q3 weakness if bearish sentiment continues to decline. Critical of credit card cap proposal but sees it as unlikely to pass. Adobe and Salesforce remain weak despite good fundamentals.
key_takeaways: Amazon and Celsius are top 2026 picks - both already up 7%+ and 16% YTD
American Express is an 'easy buy' - credit card cap fear overblown for their high-income customer base
Expect low volatility in 2026 - VIX down 22%, hard to get another spike without black swan
Q1 economic data likely strong, but watch for Q2-Q3 problems if sentiment gets too bullish
Adobe and Salesforce are 'incredibly weak' despite good numbers - avoid
SoFi has risk from credit card cap proposal affecting their personal loan arbitrage model
